task:
Open Obsidian with the vault at /home/user/Documents/HotkeyVault. Set up the following custom keyboard shortcuts:

1. Set 'Toggle bold' (editor:toggle-bold) to Ctrl+Alt+B
2. Set 'Toggle italic' (editor:toggle-italics) to Ctrl+Alt+I
3. Set 'Toggle strikethrough' (editor:toggle-strikethrough) to Ctrl+Shift+X
4. Set 'Toggle highlight' (editor:toggle-highlight) to Ctrl+Shift+H
5. Set 'Insert template' (insert-template) to Ctrl+T

After setting all hotkeys, create a note 'HotkeyCheatsheet.md' with body:

# Hotkey Cheatsheet
## Formatting
- Bold: Ctrl+Alt+B
- Italic: Ctrl+Alt+I
- Strikethrough: Ctrl+Shift+X
- Highlight: Ctrl+Shift+H
## Templates
- Insert: Ctrl+T
#hotkeys #cheatsheet

verification.eval: any(sorted(b.get('modifiers') or []) == ['Alt', 'Mod'] and str(b.get('key', '')).upper() == 'B' for b in (result.get('bindings') or []))
any(sorted(b.get('modifiers') or []) == ['Alt', 'Mod'] and str(b.get('key', '')).upper() == 'I' for b in (result.get('bindings') or []))

cli_feasibility.translation: 1) 修改 .obsidian/hotkeys.json 设置自定义快捷键; 2) 使用 cli-anything-obsidian vault create 创建 HotkeyCheatsheet.md
